typst.description: Modern typesetting system for technical documents with math, code, and bibliography support
typst.usage:
typst compile document.typ # Compile Typst document to PDF
typst watch document.typ # Watch and auto-compile on changes
typst compile document.typ --output output.pdf # Specify output file
typst compile --format png document.typ # Export as PNG images
typst --help # Show all available commands and options

description: Modern typesetting system with mathematical typesetting, syntax highlighting, and bibliography support
name: typst
